**Reject odd half-precision head strides before the head-group fold.** For an f16 or bf16 `dq` or `dk` output, `head_group_reduce` converts the head stride from elements to 32-bit words with `// 2`. **Reject odd half-precision head strides before the head-group fold.** For an f16 or bf16 `dq` or `dk` output, `head_group_reduce` converts the head stride from elements to 32-bit words with `// 2`. The reducer documents that these outer strides must be even. The layout check accepts any tensor whose innermost stride is 1. A 16-bit view with strides `(258, 129, 1)` can pass that check. Its odd head stride is then halved to 64 words, so head 1 is written at element 128 instead of 129. The gradient is silently corrupted. The same applies to `dk`. Decline these strides before the kernel launches:
Suggested fix
```diff dst_strides = tuple(dst.stride()) + if not is_fp32 and any(s % 2 for s in dst_strides[:-1]): + raise ValueError( + "head_group_reduce: f16/bf16 dst outer strides must be even; " + f"got {dst_strides}" + ) out_row_words = dst_strides[0] if is_fp32 else dst_strides[0] // 2 ```
